steps.body: On the hundred chart, moving up one row subtracts ten — the mirror of moving down to add ten.
steps.narration: On the hundred chart, moving up one row subtracts ten — the mirror of moving down to add ten.

widget.prompt: On the hundred chart, hop up one row from 58 (subtract ten).
widget.missFeedback: Start at 58 and count back 10: you land on 48.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 48 — moving up one row on the chart subtracts ten.

predict.prompt: On a hundred chart, which direction subtracts ten?
predict.reveal: Moving up one row goes back a whole ten, since each row is a new ten.

explanationVariants: The hundred chart makes the tens-only subtraction visible as a move up a row.
This matches exactly what happens when you subtract ten mentally.

commonErrors.feedback: That changes by one instead of ten.
